About.title: How to interpret the data
About.introduction: DataEmpregos is an independent visualization of monthly formal-employment movements published through Novo CAGED.
About.dataset: The data originates with Brazil's Ministry of Labor and Employment, through Novo CAGED files.
About.grouping: Results are grouped by geography and CBO occupational family.
About.movements: Admissions and dismissals are recorded movements; they are not a complete count of everyone employed.
About.cltCoverage: The metrics cover formal employment relationships governed by the CLT; arrangements outside that regime are not part of this visualization.
About.salary: Average admission salary refers to the admission salary field in the dataset, not the average salary of everyone in an occupational family. Pay for each hire can vary substantially by role, seniority, and other factors. Values are nominal Brazilian reais.
About.revisions: Official data can be revised, and this project's processing or presentation may contain omissions, delays, or errors.
About.independence: This is an independent experimental project. It is not an official service, is not supported or endorsed by a government body, and may contain errors!
About.officialSource: Consult the official Novo CAGED source

Footer.disclaimerSource: For official or authoritative use, consult the public Novo CAGED source.
